reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 17 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The high bald crown with short brown side/back hair and short sideburns remains, together with thin dark brows and round thin-framed glasses. The dark-brown moustache is retained above one neutral serious closed mouth, while the chin remains smooth with no beard. The nearly frontal upright pose and direct gaze remain. The medium-gray suit, white pointed shirt collar and dark reddish-brown tie remain without added decorations. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The note has two upper gray-mark rows and a small dark right-edge tab; there is no clear added third row or distinct lower writing cluster, and the lower paper remains largely blank. The complete thin dark frame and opaque dark blue-gray backplate remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine glasses-rim detail and note glyphs are too small to read at source scale. A few faint lower-paper specks are visible in the native crop, but they cannot be reliably classified as intentional added writing rather than paper-aging texture; this uncertainty was not used as a standalone rejection reason and no clear extra row or distinct writing cluster is present.
